<a id="v1-7-10-english"></a>
### English

> SSH key management works more reliably, and completed downloads refresh their destination automatically. Browser file tabs can access this computer or the Terma device and offer overwrite or rename choices for same-name files. A native fnOS package is now available.

#### Important fixes

- SSH private-key imports now work correctly. Imported keys produce usable public keys, keys without a separate public file can be viewed and edited, and attempts to delete a key used by a connection explain how to resolve it.
- Database restore confirmation now accounts for newly bound keys and no longer warns that those connections will lose their key bindings.
- Sending remote files to a Windows file pane now adapts unsupported characters and reserved names, keeping existing files as separate copies.
- Downloads saved on the Terma device now refresh open file panes automatically. Completion notices and task history show the final name when a file was renamed.

#### Important additions

- Browser Local Files tabs can now open folders on this computer or the Terma device, with SFTP uploads and downloads. The redesigned device view shows accessible drives, actual paths and navigation history; fnOS keeps App Center folder authorization. Plain HTTP browsers use read-only folder selection and browser-managed downloads.
- Sending files to a browser file tab offers Overwrite, Auto-rename or Cancel for same-name files, then shows the final names. Folder and file-type conflicts keep the existing items and use separately named copies.
- Select a file or folder in SFTP, then click its name again after a pause to rename it inline. Double-click still opens the item.
- Added a native fnOS package for SSH, SFTP and bundled browser noVNC, with an illustrated introduction, installation password confirmation, App Center password and network settings, start/stop controls and backups before upgrades. Reinstalling with retained data uses the newly entered password; upgrades keep the existing one. Desktop-only features and scheduled SFTP sync remain unavailable in this package.
- Unrecognized access hostnames now show a Chinese/English explanation with setup instructions; API requests retain structured errors.

#### Changes in this release

- Release v1.7.10: native fnOS packages and browser file management ([#62](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/pull/62), @JunXiaoRuo).

**Full Changelog**: [v1.7.9...v1.7.10](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/compare/v1.7.9...v1.7.10)

<a id="v1-7-10-zh"></a>
### 简体中文

> 修复 SSH 密钥管理问题，下载完成后自动刷新目标目录。浏览器文件标签可访问当前电脑或 Terma 所在设备，同名文件可选择覆盖或重命名；同时提供飞牛原生安装包。

#### 重要修复

- 修复 SSH 私钥导入失败和导入后公钥格式不正确的问题。没有单独公钥文件的密钥也可查看和编辑；删除正在使用的密钥时，会明确提示处理方法。
- 数据库恢复确认页会计算新绑定的密钥，不再误报这些连接将失去密钥绑定。
- 远端文件发送到 Windows 文件标签时会适配不支持的字符和保留名称，同名文件另存副本，保留已有内容。
- 下载保存到 Terma 所在设备后会自动刷新已打开的目录；发生重命名时，完成通知和任务记录会显示最终文件名。

#### 重要新增

- 浏览器新增本地文件标签，可选择当前电脑或 Terma 所在设备，并与 SFTP 上传下载。重新设计的设备视图显示可访问磁盘、实际路径和导航历史，飞牛继续使用应用中心目录授权；普通 HTTP 浏览器使用只读文件夹选择和浏览器下载。
- 发送到浏览器文件标签遇到同名文件时可选择覆盖、自动重命名或取消，完成后显示最终名称。文件夹或类型冲突会保留原有项目并另存副本。
- SFTP 选中文件或文件夹后，稍后再次单击名称可直接改名，双击仍然打开项目。
- 新增飞牛原生安装包，可通过浏览器使用 SSH、SFTP 和内置 noVNC，提供图文介绍、安装密码确认、应用中心密码与网络设置、启停控制和升级前备份；保留数据重装时使用本次填写的密码，正常升级保留原密码。桌面专属功能与定时 SFTP 同步暂不可用。
- 访问未允许的主机名时显示可切换中英文的说明和设置方法，API 请求继续返回结构化错误。

#### 本次变更

- 发布 v1.7.10：飞牛原生包与浏览器文件管理（[#62](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/pull/62)，@JunXiaoRuo）。
